# c-hash-tables

This project is an attempt to build my own versions of `hash mapping` in C.

The goal is to make my own implementation of hash maps that include:

- Scaling +/- hash maps given a certain load
- Linked lists 
- Efficient memory usage


## How to try it

### 1. Clone the repository

```bash
git clone <repository-url>
cd chashtables
```

### 2. Build the project

```bash
make
```

This builds:

```bash
./program
```

### 3. Run the program

```bash
make run
```

### 4. Clean generated files

```bash
make clean
```
